doc.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
doc.interviewee: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams

chapter: Williams on guitarists, family and touring
title: Williams's voice and white audiences passing the hat
summary: Williams says his voice has weakened, and recalls playing for white folks who dropped money in a hat.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Well, uh, in my time of playing guitar, well, I had a fast chord I used to carry. But I don't care no more and I just wonder why. I don't care. I just got there. Well, it's something my tune is kind of fast. Mm-hmm. And some of them, they ain't too slow. I never play too slow. But in my playing, before, I used to have a voice. I could, I could scream. Just bring my voice down just like I want it. But this touch, the one that was so close on me, see that cuts my speech. Mm-hmm. And there's a lot of people, they used to have us to play up there. Miss, Miss Albert is out down the plank road. You know Miss Charleston store. Yeah. Well, they had a fellow up there. He was a me-mind-giving. And me, so he would be up there playing. And they'd have me. So those white folks that were before they heard me. And they just put their head down and just drop money. For me. All I had to put my hand down and me. And they said, boy, they just be dropping money in the head for me. and it had me, so those white folks said it before, who hear me, and they just put their hat down and just drop money for me. All I had to put money and receive was and they just be dropping money in the hat for me. It was sad tonight, while I was playing at it, they was coming, yes. Those white folks was coming up there while I was playing at it. I could, when I take the blues, I could just sit down and just hoop. I can't sing so good now. If they have to send me to the hospital, I'ma tell them about this, my voice, you know? Oh yeah. Yes. And then I'm gonna try to get on some blues. Take it, yes. But I'm making it pretty good, like it is. Yes, pretty good.
